description:
The world is yours with almost 200 areas and tens of thousands of cities in Fly Corp to add to your network. Keep in mind that each continent has its challenges and special conditions, so you’ll have to adapt and think ahead to succeed.

Connect cities around the globe and upgrade your planes and airports for increased efficiency and capacity. But choose wisely when developing any destination, as your resources are limited, and you don’t want to let any of the airports become overloaded, otherwise, that’s it for your company!

Play as you like with the Discover the World, Free Play, and Scenarios game modes. And challenge other players to reach the top of the Leaderboard!
name: Fly Corp
intro: Build a thriving airline enterprise, connect the entire world with your network, keep an eye on your aircraft park and airports, and don’t keep your passengers waiting.
